title: When the Oath Sings Revisited
author: Ulyana Galloway
blurb: Marguerite Ravensworth, the youngest member of a dying guild, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
